requirements.text: After a synchronous reset (rst_n low at a rising clk edge), empty=1, full=0 and count=0.
Data is read in the order it was written. Whenever empty=0, rd_data shows the oldest stored word (first-word fall-through); rd_en=1 at a rising edge removes it.
A write while full=1 is ignored: stored data and count are unchanged by the write, even if rd_en=1 in the same cycle.
A read while empty=1 is ignored: count stays 0 and no underflow occurs.
count equals the number of stored words; full=1 exactly when count=DEPTH; empty=1 exactly when count=0.
A simultaneous read and write when the FIFO is neither empty nor full leaves count unchanged and preserves order.
